snippet.title: Realm of Taiwu // Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3452720/Realm_of_Taiwu

Realm of Taiwu is a The Scroll of Taiwu spin-off. The story unfolds across an alternate branching timeline of the original universe: the Taiwu Hero never arrives, the Fuyu Sword falls to Xiangshu, and the world sinks into endless darkness.

👥 Players: Single Player, Online Co-op
🛠️ Developer: Leap Studio
📚 Publisher:  4Divinity
📅 Early Access Release Date: Oct 15, 2026
🎯 Genre: Action, Indie, RPG, Early Access
